entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: An ancient planeswalker and master blacksmith forced into the service of Geyadrone Dihada after forging the Blackblade.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: A planeswalker who offered to ignite Dakkon's spark in return for the Blackblade, then stole his shadow and bound him to her.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A soul-drinking sword forged by Dakkon at Dihada's request, which can no longer hurt an elder dragon.

entities.name: Daron
entities.description: Dakkon's son, whom he was willing to sacrifice to the blade.

entities.name: Son of Carth
entities.description: A young thief from the fallen kingdom of Carth who bound himself to Dakkon with the Amulet of Ti-Fu and started the Carthalion legacy.

entities.name: Amulet of Ti-Fu
entities.description: An artifact that binds Dakkon to Carth, stopping him planeswalking and tying his death to Carth's.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: Dihada's corrupted Maro-Sorcerer, bested by Dakkon.

entities.name: Piru
entities.description: An Elder Dragon summoned by Dihada and killed by Dakkon with the Blackblade.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: An Elder Dragon summoned by Dihada and banished by Dakkon.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: The last surviving Carthalion at the time of the Planeswalkers' War of Corondor.

entities.name: Korlash
entities.description: An undead being who claimed the Blackblade.

entities.name: Needle
entities.description: A Cabal minion into whose possession the Blackblade came.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The Cabal's new leader, credited in rewritten history with forging the Blackblade.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who used the Blackblade against Bolas, and it broke.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who had enchanted the Blackblade never to hurt another elder dragon.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: The island where Dihada began a war and later took control.

entities.name: Dueling Chasm of Golthonor
entities.description: A chasm created by the blast when Dakkon killed Piru.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent where Dakkon and the boy traveled.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: The academy at Lat-Nam that Dihada took control of in 4562.

events.summary: Dihada offers to make Dakkon a planeswalker if he forges the Blackblade, and he forges it over ten years, killing a slave with it each time.
events.quote: offered to make him a planeswalker if he would make her the most powerful blade in existence, the Blackblade .

events.summary: Dakkon becomes Dakkon Blackblade through his slaughter; Dihada ignites his spark but stabs the sword into his shadow and binds his soul into the blade.
events.quote: she stabbed the sword into Dakkon's shadow and absorbed his soul but not his life.

events.summary: The Son of Carth escapes Dihada's dungeons and uses the Amulet of Ti-Fu to bind himself to Dakkon.
events.quote: The boy (known as the Son of Carth ) used the Amulet of Ti-Fu to bind himself to Dakkon

events.summary: Dakkon bests Sol'Kanar, banishes Chromium and kills Piru with the Blackblade, creating the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.
events.quote: This released a massive energy blast that created the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor .

events.summary: Dihada reveals the monk was herself, absorbs Piru's soul, and her glyph steals Dakkon's spark and binds him to her for eternity.
events.quote: She then revealed to Carth that the monk who had set Carth on his quest was none other than Dihada herself.

events.summary: Dakkon and the boy travel to Terisiare, where the boy starts the Carthalion legacy.
events.quote: the boy started the Carthalion legacy, named after Dakkon's nickname for the boy, "Carth the Lion".

events.summary: Gideon Jura uses the Blackblade against Bolas, but it breaks against his flesh.
events.quote: the planeswalker Gideon Jura used the Blackblade to attack Nicol Bolas , but the sword broke against the Elder Dragon's flesh.

events.summary: In 4562 Dihada returns to Dominaria, takes the Tolarian Academy and Corondor, hoping to force Jared Carthalion into a conflict that returns Dakkon to her.
events.quote: In 4562, Dihada returned to Dominaria to take control of the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam .

relations.quote: was forced into the service of Geyadrone Dihada
his sword: the Blackblade , which he forged using magic and dark rituals.
Piru then fought him but was killed when Dakkon stabbed her with the Blackblade
Dakkon was willing to sacrifice even his son Daron to the blade in his quest for power.

relations.note: Bound to Dakkon through the amulet; they became allies against Dihada.
relations.quote: And serve he did, happily, when he learned of Carth's enemy, Dihada herself.
when he learned of Carth's enemy, Dihada herself.
